messages:
sara_research: Hey team — incoming customer request to onboard a new model 'kite-6b' (open checkpoint) into Dedicated. HIPAA customer, prefers private deployment. Observed issues: hallucinations on clinical summarization prompts and tokenization oddities. Can we triage quantization and quality before we approve Dedicated onboarding? Link to artifact: s3://redwood-models/kite-6b/v1. Customer notes target latency p50 120ms, throughput ~40 qps/GPU.

maria_ml: @sara_research noted. Can you confirm: model format (hf/ggml?), tokenizer type, and a small repro prompt set? Also whether they already tried int8.

sara_research: They uploaded HF repo (transformers checkpoint + tokenizer.json). Repro prompts at s3://redwood-evals/kite6b/clinical-summarize-suite.jsonl. Customer ran static int8 using bitsandbytes and saw ~2-3% ROUGE drop + hallucinations on ~6 prompts. They didn't try per-channel quantization.

maria_ml: OK. I'll spin up a quick quant smoke. Plan: run FP16 baseline -> int8 static -> int8+perchannel (if supported) -> q4_0/q4_1 (LLM.int8 fallback?) and collect ROUGE/EM/hallucination flags + latency. Command I'll run: ```python infra/eval/run_eval.py --model s3://redwood-models/kite-6b/v1 --prompts s3://redwood-evals/kite6b/clinical-summarize-suite.jsonl --output /tmp/kite6b-smoke.json --quant {none,int8,perchannel,q4_0} --batch 8 --max_len 512```

jason_infra: Heads-up — Dedicated pool "hipaa-dedicated-eu" currently has 20% headroom but we need to reserve nodes for rollout if we approve. Also want to know if KV cache fits 40 qps target on A10G vs A100. Please include perf numbers.

oliver_se: Quick note: tokenizer differences often cause hallucinations for clinical prompts if special tokens are dropped. Maria, include tokenization validation: run `tokenizer.tokenize(prompt)` and compare token ids between HF and Redwood tokenizers. If mismatch, try adding special_tokens or using HF tokenizer directly.

triage-bot: Intake form recorded: model=kite-6b, customer=tbd (enterprise hipaa), distro=hf, requested_quant_profiles=[int8,perchannel,q4], latency_target_p50=120ms, throughput_target=40qps/GPU, privacy=HIPAA. Ticket=#MK-4521.

maria_ml: Early smoke results (summary): FP16 baseline ROUGE-L=37.2, int8 static ROUGE-L=35.1, int8+perchannel ROUGE-L=36.9. Latency p50 (A10G): FP16=95ms, int8=78ms, perchannel int8=82ms. Observed hallucination cluster on prompts 3/6 in static int8 only. q4_0 gave worse ROUGE ~33.5.

sara_research: Thanks. Sounds like per-channel int8 looks promising. Can we run targeted evals focusing on named-entity hallucination and calibration? Also create a quality regression alert for downstream customers if we flip quant profile.

maria_ml: I'll run named-entity hallucination classifier + confusion matrix tomorrow. Proposed rollout policy: canary on 10% traffic to perchannel-int8; fallback to fp16 for flagged prompt types or if hallucination score > threshold. Draft rollout snippet for Console: ```rollout: - canary: 10% model: kite-6b:perchannel-int8 - threshold: hallucination_score>0.12 -> fallback: kite-6b:fp16```

oliver_se: For the HIPAA customer we need KMS integration for keys and ensure model artifact is stored in private bucket. Ops: @jason_infra can we pin this to dedicated-nodes with HSM enabled?

jason_infra: Yes, we can pin to hipaa-dedicated-eu and attach KMS. I'll reserve 2 nodes for the canary; need approval from finance if sustained.

maria_ml: Action items: 1) Run named-entity hallucination suite (maria_ml) — ETA 24h. 2) Tokenizer diffs + patch (oliver_se) — ETA 48h. 3) Perf validation A100 vs A10G (jason_infra) — ETA 48h. 4) Draft rollout policy & eval thresholds (maria_ml) — ETA 48h. I'll post full smoke logs and eval artifacts here when done. :white_check_mark:

sara_research: Perfect. Please tag #mk-4521 when you upload results. If perchannel-int8 holds on hallucination tests, we can greenlight Dedicated onboarding with canary + automatic rollback.

maria_ml: Uploaded smoke logs: s3://redwood-results/kite6b/smoke-3341209876.tar.gz — includes eval CSVs and latencies. Next update by 3341290000.
